programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Josh dice que su mundo se arruinó cuando su novia dio a luz a su hijo, por lo que se acostó con su hermana; Derrick quiere dejar a su novio para poder ser soltero, libre y capaz de hacer sus propias cosas.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: La stripper Brittany se enfrenta a un compañero de trabajo que se acostó con uno de los clientes de Brittany; la mamá del bebé de Bebo confiesa haberse acostado con su mejor amigo; tres invitados le dan una sorpresa.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Carl ha venido a decirle a su novia que se ha estado acostando con su peor enemiga, Keisha. A continuación, Donte le dirá a su mejor amigo, Quincy, que está acostándose con su prometida. Después, Janel y Nikkie están peleando por el mismo hombre.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Johnny quiere que su novia Aimee lo acepte como es. Después, Maya viene al programa para confrontar a su novio Eric sobre sus costumbres.

programme.title: Jerry Springer
programme.desc: Destiny confiesa una aventura; Kashe admite acostarse con la novia de su primo y estalla pelea; dos hombres compiten en un concurso de comida para conquistar a Amber.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Colombia es el tercer destino preferido para cirugías plásticas, pero muchos extranjeros han fallecido durante estos procedimientos. Casos como el de María Isabel Rosado y Maira Sánchez revelan riesgos y negligencias médicas. Se buscan regulaciones más estrictas para proteger a los pacientes.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Marco Lino Niño, Ana Julia Sánchez y Rosa Helena Restrepo sufrieron maltratos en hogares geriátricos, resultando en sus muertes. Sus familias buscan justicia y denuncian negligencia y maltrato. Las investigaciones están en curso, mientras los hogares siguen operando.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: El juicio por el asesinato de María Mercedes Gnecco se ha convertido en un caso de gran controversia. La Fiscalía acusa a su esposo, de montar una escena para ocultar su culpabilidad. La investigación revela posibles motivos económicos.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Juan José, de 7 años, falleció ahogado en una piscina sin salvavidas en Melgar. Deisy Riaño murió y su pareja quedó en estado vegetativo por inhalar monóxido de carbono en un glamping sin licencia en Manta. César Bolaños se ahogó en el Parque Tayrona, donde no había salvavidas. Las familias buscan justicia.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Los adolescentes luchan contra trastornos de salud mental que les hacen terminar prematuramente con sus vidas.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: En Colombia, la compra de SIM Cards prepago sin cédula facilita delitos como extorsión y robo de celulares. Miller Steven Falla fue asesinado por su celular, mostrando la gravedad del problema. Expertos y autoridades piden registro obligatorio para reducir estos crímenes.

programme.title: Séptimo Día
programme.desc: Dos hombres usan alias en Tinder para estafar a varias mujeres por miles de dólares.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Calarcá, Quindío, las primas Luz Enith y Jenny Andrea Morales fueron halladas estranguladas en 2016. La investigación reveló que Jenny mantenía una relación con su ex esposo, Fabián Rendón, quien motivado por celos y venganza planeó el doble feminicidio junto a su cómplice Sebastián Muriel, administrador de un hotel local. Fabián confesó el crimen y señaló a Muriel como coautor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: El veintiuno (21) de abril de dos mil once (2011) en Caicedonia (Valle) ocurre el atroz asesinato de Jenifer Hoyos una niña de nueve (9) años a manos de Yeison Leandro Ortiz un amigo de la familia.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: Sandra seduce y manipula a su joven amante Gyan Carlos, convenciéndolo de asesinar a su esposo Mauricio a cambio de amor y una vida juntos. Sin saberlo, Gyan Carlos no era el único hombre bajo su control. Tras el crimen, errores de novatos facilitaron la investigación, llevando tanto a Sandra como a su amante a pagar una larga condena en prisión.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2010, en Villavicencio, Meta, una granada estalló en la casa de la familia Prieto Valencia, matando a Isis Andrea, de solo 7 años, y herido a su hermano Marco Andrés. El principal sospechoso, Carlos Efraín Sánchez, expareja violenta de Estefany Prieto, huyó tras el ataque pero fue capturado en 2011. En 2013 fue condenado a 56 años de prisión por terrorismo, homicidio agravado y otros delitos.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En 2013, Bryan Steven Rivera, un niño de 7 años, desapareció en la zona cafetera de Colombia; una testigo relató que un hombre lo atrajo con dulces. La investigación llevó a un retrato hablado de "El Peruano", identificado como Carlos Alberto Gómez Loaiza, con antecedentes por abuso sexual violento. Reconocido por testigos, fue detenido en Pereira para responder por la desaparición del menor.

programme.title: El Rastro
programme.desc: En Armenia, un niño de 6 años fue hallado sin vida en el río Quindío. La investigación inicial sospechó de sus padres y de Jhony, mayordomo de una finca cercano a la madre, Liliana. Evidencias reconstructivas señalaron a Jhony como el principal sospechoso. En el juicio, confesó su participación y reveló que su jefe fue cómplice y autor directo del crimen. Jhony fue condenado a 40 años, pero su jefe fue absuelto por falta de pruebas.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Michael Brown demanda a Víctor Hernández, propietario de la tienda de tatuajes "Savage Skin", por 50.000 dólares, alegando que Víctor alteró maliciosamente el diseño de su tatuaje debido a un rencor por salir con la ex de Víctor, provocando un tatuaje vergonzoso. Víctor dice que es un malentendido.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Barbara demanda al club de striptease de Emilio por 30.000 dólares, alegando negligencia y angustia emocional. Ella afirma haber sufrido un latigazo cervical por la actuación de Jackson y una silla que se derrumbó. Emilio niega su responsabilidad, citando la seguridad y el consumo de alcohol de Bárbara.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Wilbur y su esposa, Lucia, están demandando a la hermana de Wilbur, Jennifer, por $200,000 después de que su hijo quedó fuera del testamento de su abuela.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Gabriella está demandando a su ex empleadora, Jaqueline Mendoza, por $600,000 por angustia mental y despido injustificado luego de sufrir un ataque de pánico durante una celebración de la empresa.

programme.title: Juez Mom
programme.desc: Samantha demanda a Elizabeth y al investigador privado Ricardo por 40.000 dólares por acusaciones falsas. Elizabeth contrató a Ricardo para investigar al marido de Samantha, pero acusó erróneamente a Samantha. Samantha denuncia acoso y difamación. Elizabeth y Ricardo niegan responsabilidad.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Michell, de 13 años, tuvo gemelos prematuros tras huir de Venezuela a Colombia. Sin recursos y con apoyo solo de su madre, lucha por la salud de sus bebés en hospitales de Cúcuta mientras enfrenta rechazo familiar. Su historia refleja la devastadora realidad del embarazo infantil en Latinoamérica, donde miles de niñas enfrentan riesgos de salud, pobreza y abandono cada año.

programme.title: Los Informantes
programme.desc: Gustavo Quintana, "el doctor muerte," falleció tras realizar más de 500 eutanasias a pacientes terminales que buscaban una muerte digna. Yolanda Chaparro, diagnosticada con ELA, luchó un año contra el sistema de salud para lograr su derecho a morir en paz. Horas antes de su eutanasia, Yolanda recibió una serenata de su familia, sonriendo pese a las circunstancias.

The intensity builds as he and the crew track the striking White Blesbuck across the open plains and pursue the Tsessebe — one of the fastest antelope species in Africa.

programme.title: The Journey Within

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Spring in Michigan means turkey season is on. In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew returns for Turkey Camp 2025, where changing weather, early mornings, and vocal birds set the tone for the week. After dialing in their setups at the range, the team heads into the field to chase gobblers across hardwoods and open farmland. From patient sits at sunrise to midday moves and carefully planned decoy strategies, each hunt brings new challenges and opportunities. Close encounters, tough conditions, and well-timed shots highlight the grind of spring turkey hunting, as the crew makes the most of every chance in the Michigan woods.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Kodiak Island, Alaska, in pursuit of blacktail deer in some of the most remote terrain they’ve faced. After a multi-day journey by air - and sea, they arrive in a landscape defined by steep mountains, thick brush, and ever-changing weather. Once on the ground, the team confirms their setups and puts Winchester’s Supreme Long Range ammunition to the test as they glass expansive hillsides, pick apart coastal terrain, and carefully plan each move. From quick opportunities along the shoreline to calculated stalks in the high country, every moment demands focus and precision. Against the backdrop of Alaska’s wild beauty, this episode highlights the challenge, the strategy, and the performance it takes to capitalize when the opportunity finally comes together.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Opening day in Mississippi has arrived and Slade is taking full advantage of it! With the weather not cooperating Slade and Zeb stumble into a turkey hunt they won't soon forget. Two days later, the hot streak continues with Slade connecting on another turkey on an 83 acre property he has for sale! Also, Slade gives some tips and his ideas on small acreage hunting, and how it can be just as lucrative as big tracks of land!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode, Slade and his son take on the turkey woods for an afternoon hunt. And boy was it an action packed hunt! Jakes, hens, and tons of gobbles, This hunt is spectacular! Lastly, Slade introduces a property that we have already made a video on, but with just how amazing the land is, we had to include it! Floweree is the epitome of a sportsman's paradise!

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: We are blessed for the opportunity to follow along the guys from Trinity Oaks for Bucks for the Brave. The men and women that served in our armed services and as first responders, had jobs that required the, to be willing to sacrifice their own lives every day, in order to protect or save someone else's. Not many of us can say that, nor understand what that truly means. The things they've had to see, and the sacrifices they've made in their daily lives, can have a profound impact on them. Trinity Oaks' Bucks for the Brave platform allows the loved ones and communities that support these heroes to share their stories and unite us all in honoring and recognizing their service to our great nation. We are proud to continue to be a part of this incredible program, getting these heroes in the outdoors for the hunt of a lifetime.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Who has stolen Pooky? After a night drying on the clothes line, Pooky has disappeared, and Garfield can't sleep without him.

programme.desc: It's night-time and the full moon and the alignment of the planets are having a strange effect on Odie.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Liz's parents are coming over to meet Jon and Jon really has to make a good impression.

programme.title: The Garfield Show

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There is a Pet Show in town, and the winner will get a huge lasagna from Vito's restaurant. That's worth trying for Garfield. But Nermal is in the competition too...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: There's a new TV Show called "Instant Petmatching", which is about seeing if pets are matching with their owner. The result of the test is that Jon and Garfield are incompatible!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie finds the pot of gold at the bottom of a rainbow. The owner, a leprechaun, will grant all the wishes Garfield can think of.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Odie has found a strange, big bone in the garden. After some research, Garfield has found that it might be a dinosaur bone, and that could make him rich... enough for having lasagna forever, at least!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: A salesman has sold Jon a cleaning Robot, which is very annoying to his two pets.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is really unhappy because he has to be on diet. And he's having nightmares about it.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon can't manage to sleep. He's tried everything, to no avail. But Dr. Somnambulo has a new machine: the hypno-doron, still in work-in-progress.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Liz brings back an old mirror from her travels in Egypt. This one is enchanted and opens a door towards ancient Egypt where a Goddess, Neferkitty, has a secret wish: conquering the human world.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Two little devilish girls are coming visiting Jon. They really want to play dolls with Garfield and Odie, who only want to stay clear from them.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield is stuck in a parallel world where cats have taken the place of humans, and vice versa!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon sends Garfield to Dr Whipple's Show in order for him to learn how to be a well-behaved cat.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield accidentally climbs into an outer space traveller's car, which sends him into parallel worlds.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Sir Leo, a famous TV Actor, looks very much like Garfield. So when he has to go on vacations, Garfield takes his place and gets to taste celebrity and glitter.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Our heroes are on a fishing trip. Odie saves a little fish and goes to explore the underwater world with Garfield.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Liz asks Jon to look after her goldfish while she's out of town. When Garfield finds this out, all he can think about is the great fry-up he's going to have.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Our friends are having a picnic by the lake. There's an extra guest: a cute little wolf, who will become Odie's new friend.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Garfield finds a watch which can stop time.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's Liz's birthday and Jon wants to offer her a special gift: a nice family portrait. But taking this picture will be a gruelling experience for Garfield, Odie and Jon...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Professor Bonker has a new invention: the "Virtualodeon", which will bring the characters of Garfield's favourite TV Shows right into his living-room.

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Herman the Postman is going on holidays. He has left his round to the young Steart O'Meara, who hasn't yet encountered all of Garfield's devilish traps...

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: It's winter and Garfield and his friends, Odie and Nermal, are competing for the price of "the best Christmas carolling singer". There are cookies at stake!

programme.title: The Garfield Show
programme.desc: Jon's cousin has passed away and has left his fortune to Jon and Doc Boy. But there's one condition: the one who will spend an entire night in a spooky manor will be the one to inherit everything.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About That!

programme.title: Eddie Pepitone: In Ruins
programme.desc: Eddie Pepitone delivers a dark, rage-fueled stand-up set in Brooklyn, blending sharp humor with reflections on modern life and the American Dream.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with comedian and host Jessi Cruickshank for a fast, funny conversation about boy-band fandom, parenting twins (and a third kid), and finding sanity on tour. They swap stories on public-parent life, the joys and chaos of twinhood, and how identity, confidence, and career evolve with family.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Give It Up: The Greatest Concert of Comedy Songs
programme.desc: Filmed live in Los Angeles, Avery Pearson hosts a one-night-only comedy concert blending music, satire, and stand-up. Featuring Jay Pharoah, Arden Myrin, Adam Ray, Beth Stelling, Luke Null, JR De Guzman, Jeremiah Watkins, Josh Adam Meyers, and more, the show delivers original comedy songs and musical parodies about life, fame, and delusion.

programme.title: Catherine Cohen: Come For Me
programme.desc: In this acclaimed one-woman show, comedian and cabaret star Catherine Cohen delivers a sharp, musical, and self-aware exploration of modern womanhood. Blending stand-up, original songs, and theatrical flair, Cohen takes the audience through her thoughts on dating, therapy, faith, and self-image — all with biting wit, charm, and glitter. Filmed live in New York City, Come For Me celebrates confidence, vulnerability, and the chaos of being thirty and thriving.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Carly Pearce on Artist Friendly. Pearce reflects on leaving high school at 16 for Dollywood, moving to Nashville at 19, and years of grinding before her breakthrough. She opens up about trusting her instincts, turning heartbreak into Grammy-winning music, and making peace with the hardest chapters of her story.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Morgan Lander, frontwoman of Canadian heavy metal band Kittie, joins Joel Madden to discuss breaking into the metal scene as teenage girls, reclaiming power in a male-dominated industry, and redefining success on their own terms. Lander reflects on burnout, body autonomy, and growing up in the spotlight before returning stronger than ever.

programme.title: Phantogram: Live at the Hollywood Palladium Los Angeles
programme.desc: Phantogram perform a sold-out Running Through Colors Tour set at the Hollywood Palladium in Los Angeles. Highlights include “Mouthful of Diamonds” and “Fall in Love.”

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Magnolia Park frontman Joshua Roberts joins Joel Madden for a heartfelt conversation about anime, identity, and carving out space in rock music. Joshua reflects on navigating racism in the scene, channeling emotion into art, and leading Magnolia Park’s creative community with resilience and purpose. From social media strategy to self-belief, this episode dives deep into what it means to stay authentic while inspiring others to do the same.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: GRAMMY-winning singer-songwriter Brandon Lake joins Joel Madden to talk balancing fame and family, using music to share his relationship with faith, and previewing his upcoming album King of Hearts. He opens up about hiring a performance/health coach for life on tour, dialing in nutrition and strength training, life on a new South Carolina farm, growing up in church and learning guitar, and the joy of community in music—from a viral onstage “Higher” moment to swapping stories about Creed and meeting Scott Stapp.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum rapper/producer G-Eazy sits down with Joel Madden to talk brotherhood, the early grind, and returning to the road after a six-year hiatus. From funny tangents (the philosophy of milkshakes) to reflective moments about not fitting in growing up, finding belonging in music, and dedicating part of his show to his late mom, Gerald shares why performing completes the art—and how a whirlwind London stop let him share the stage with his brother James. He also recalls his first runs back (including arena-scale crowds in India) and the community that’s formed around his all-black stage persona.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Multi-platinum singer-songwriter Alec Benjamin joins Joel Madden to talk about building a sustainable career, learning from early setbacks, and prioritizing consistency over perfection. They discuss creativity in the streaming era, the role of AI in songwriting, and how Benjamin approaches authenticity and growth after a decade in music.

programme.title: +LIVE + from The Jubilee Tour
programme.desc: Iconic rock band +LIVE+ celebrates the 30th anniversary of their breakthrough album Throwing Copper with a powerful performance on The Jubilee Tour in Noblesville, Indiana. The set features career-spanning hits including “All Over You,” “Pain Lies on the Riverside,” “The Dolphin’s Cry,” and new single “Lady Bang” featuring Dean DeLeo of Stone Temple Pilots.

programme.title: Reggie Watts: Never Mind
programme.desc: Comedian, musician, and improvisational mastermind Reggie Watts takes the stage in Los Angeles for a performance that bends space, sound, and sense itself. Blending stand-up, music, and live looping, Never Mind explores technology, nostalgia, and the absurdity of modern life through spontaneous humor and sonic experimentation. Both futuristic and deeply human, this live special showcases Watts’ singular ability to find rhythm and meaning in chaos.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Lizzo shows up fully in everything she does, tracing her journey from a diamond record to a fall tour.

programme.title: NEEDTOBREATHE: The CAVES World Tour Live from Red Rocks
programme.desc: Recorded under the open sky at Red Rocks Amphitheatre in Morrison, Colorado, this concert film captures NEEDTOBREATHE at the height of The CAVES World Tour. The band delivers an expansive live set blending southern rock, gospel harmonies, and cinematic emotion. Featuring performances of “Who Am I,” “Banks,” “Fever,” and “Riding High,” the night showcases the group’s dynamic musicianship and heartfelt storytelling. $1 of each ticket supports the For Others foundation, amplifying the show’s message of hope and generosity.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden interviews Pat Monahan of Train about their success, scoring Begin Again, and the band's upcoming tour.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Tim McIlrath of Rise Against to discuss the real-world impact of music, risks that comes with standing by your convictions on stage, the vulnerability of putting your flaws into every song, and what's coming next for the band, with two new songs on the way.

programme.title: Improbably Poppy
programme.desc: Professor Poppy turns “school” upside down: a fractions lesson with a jewel-cam and a reality-bending sync glitch spirals into a nightmare of beans; a hands-on grip tutorial earns Poppy her union card; and dueling magicians escalate their rivalry from stage tricks to existential dread—before Poppy closes with a catchy lesson-on-learning performance. TV-14 (fictional violence, language).

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Judas Priest: Epitaph
programme.desc: Judas Priest performs a powerful final tour set at Hammersmith Apollo, featuring songs spanning their 40-year career.
